# UnusedGotoLabel

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Unused](/rules/#unused) · PhpStorm name: `UnusedGotoLabelInspection`

A `goto` label that no `goto` statement targets is dead code; it only
suggests control flow that does not exist. Remove it.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{6,7} [Before]
<?php
function retry_job($job)
{
    $attempts = 0;
    again:
    done:
    Again:
    if (!$job->run() && ++$attempts < 3) {
        goto again;
    }

    $cleanup = function () {
        finish:
        return true;
        goto finish;
    };
}

start:
echo "top level";
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function retry_job($job)
{
    $attempts = 0;
    again:
    if (!$job->run() && ++$attempts < 3) {
        goto again;
    }

    $cleanup = function () {
        finish:
        return true;
        goto finish;
    };
}

start:
echo "top level";
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 6: Label &#39;done&#39; is never targeted by a goto; remove it.</li>
<li>line 7: Label &#39;Again&#39; is never targeted by a goto; remove it.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnusedGotoLabel": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnusedGotoLabel

/**
 * @noinspection UnusedGotoLabelInspection
 */
```
